### CVR Energy to Release Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Results


October 20, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/146017951/files/doc_news/CVR-Energy-to-Release-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Results-2026.pdf)


SUGAR LAND, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- CVR Energy, Inc. (NYSE: CVI) plans to release its third quarter 2026 earnings results on Tuesday, November 3, before the opening of trading on the New York Stock Exchange. The Company also will host a teleconference call on Tuesday, November 3, at 1 p.m. Eastern to discuss these results.


This call, which will contain forward-looking information, will be webcast live and can be accessed on the Investor Relations section of CVR Energy’s website at[www.CVREnergy.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.CVREnergy.com&esheet=54625198&newsitemid=20261020266153&lan=en-US&anchor=www.CVREnergy.com&index=1&md5=1544fcdf6353e2cef320912b050376da) . For investors or analysts who want to participate during the call, the dial-in number is (833) 461-5787, conference ID 855547097. A repeat of the call can be accessed for seven days by dialing (833) 309-1852, conference ID 855547097. The webcast will be archived and available on the Investor Relations section of CVR Energy’s website at[www.CVREnergy.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.CVREnergy.com&esheet=54625198&newsitemid=20261020266153&lan=en-US&anchor=www.CVREnergy.com&index=2&md5=406d16c635ead17c9657ba210e1402f1) .


CVR Energy’s third quarter 2026 earnings news release will be distributed via Business Wire and posted at[www.CVREnergy.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.CVREnergy.com&esheet=54625198&newsitemid=20261020266153&lan=en-US&anchor=www.CVREnergy.com&index=3&md5=275d1867c403c5f188593afa6d3df2ce) .


**About CVR Energy, Inc.** Headquartered in Sugar Land, Texas, CVR Energy is a diversified holding company primarily engaged in the petroleum refining and marketing businesses as well as in the nitrogen fertilizer manufacturing business through its interest in CVR Partners, LP. CVR Energy subsidiaries serve as the general partner and own approximately 37 percent of the common units of CVR Partners, LP.
